tasks.title: Initialize monorepo with web/ and api/ workspaces
tasks.description:
Create the two-workspace monorepo structure with root orchestration scripts.

**What/Why:** The epic requires a `web/` (Vite React+TS) workspace and an `api/` (Express+TS) workspace. Root scripts coordinate install and run for both.

**Files:**
- `package.json` (root) — workspaces config, scripts: `install`, `dev`, `build`
- `web/package.json` — placeholder, name `@project-todo-manager/web`
- `api/package.json` — placeholder, name `@project-todo-manager/api`
- `.gitignore` — node_modules, dist, *.db files
- `tsconfig.base.json` — shared TS config for both workspaces to extend

**Approach:**
1. Create root `package.json` with `"workspaces": ["web", "api"]`
2. Add scripts: `"dev": "concurrently \"npm run dev -w api\" \"npm run dev -w web\""` etc.
3. Create `web/package.json` and `api/package.json` with placeholder scripts
4. Create shared `tsconfig.base.json` with strict mode, ES2022 target
5. Add `.gitignore` for node_modules, dist, *.sqlite, *.db

**Tests:** Run `npm install` at root — should succeed without errors.

**Acceptance:** `ls web api` shows both directories; `cat package.json` shows workspaces array; `npm install` completes.

tasks.title: Scaffold Vite React+TS app in web/
tasks.description:
Set up the Vite React+TypeScript application in the web/ workspace.

**What/Why:** REQ-027 requires React+TypeScript with Vite. This creates the runnable front-end shell.

**Files:**
- `web/package.json` — add vite, react, react-dom, typescript, @types/react, @types/react-dom
- `web/vite.config.ts` — configure React plugin, dev server port (5173), proxy /api to api server
- `web/tsconfig.json` — extends base, includes src/**/*
- `web/index.html` — entry HTML with root div
- `web/src/main.tsx` — React root render
- `web/src/App.tsx` — placeholder App component
- `web/src/vite-env.d.ts` — Vite types

**Approach:**
1. Add dependencies: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, react, react-dom, typescript, @types/*
2. Create vite.config.ts with react() plugin and proxy config `{ '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:3001' } }`
3. Create index.html, main.tsx, App.tsx with minimal "Project Todo Manager" heading
4. Add scripts: `"dev": "vite"`, `"build": "vite build"`, `"preview": "vite preview"`

**Tests:** Run `npm run dev -w web` — opens at localhost:5173 and shows heading.

**Acceptance:** `npm run dev -w web` starts successfully; browser shows React app at http://localhost:5173.

tasks.title: Configure Redux store with typed hooks in web/
tasks.description:
Set up Redux Toolkit with typed root state and typed dispatch/selector hooks.

**What/Why:** REQ-027 requires Redux for state management. Typed hooks prevent type errors throughout the app.

**Files:**
- `web/src/store/index.ts` — configureStore, export store, RootState, AppDispatch types
- `web/src/store/hooks.ts` — useAppDispatch, useAppSelector typed hooks
- `web/src/main.tsx` — wrap App with Provider
- `web/package.json` — add @reduxjs/toolkit, react-redux

**Approach:**
1. Install @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux
2. Create `store/index.ts`: `const store = configureStore({ reducer: {} })`, export `RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState>`, `AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch`
3. Create `store/hooks.ts`: typed wrappers `useAppDispatch = useDispatch.withTypes<AppDispatch>()`, `useAppSelector = useSelector.withTypes<RootState>()`
4. Update main.tsx to wrap App with `<Provider store={store}>`

**Tests:** App still renders; no console errors; TypeScript compiles.

**Acceptance:** `npm run build -w web` succeeds; store is initialized (can verify via React DevTools or console log).

tasks.title: Setup Express+TS server with health check and CORS
tasks.description:
Create the Express+TypeScript server in api/ with JSON middleware, CORS, health route, and configurable port.

**What/Why:** REQ-028 requires Express+TS API. CORS allows the Vite dev server to call the API. Health check verifies the server runs.

**Files:**
- `api/package.json` — express, cors, typescript, tsx, @types/express, @types/cors
- `api/tsconfig.json` — extends base, strict, outDir dist
- `api/src/server.ts` — Express app with middleware and health route
- `api/src/index.ts` — entry point that starts the server

**Approach:**
1. Add deps: express, cors, typescript, tsx (for dev), @types/express, @types/cors
2. Create tsconfig.json extending base with `"outDir": "dist"`, `"rootDir": "src"`
3. Create server.ts:
   - `const app = express()`
   - `app.use(cors({ origin: 'http://localhost:5173' }))`
   - `app.use(express.json())`
   - `app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => res.json({ status: 'ok' }))`
   - Export app
4. Create index.ts: `const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001; app.listen(PORT)`
5. Add scripts: `"dev": "tsx watch src/index.ts"`, `"build": "tsc"`, `"start": "node dist/index.js"`

**Tests:** `npm run dev -w api`, then `curl localhost:3001/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`

**Acceptance:** API starts on port 3001; health endpoint returns JSON; CORS headers present for localhost:5173 origin.

tasks.title: Add better-sqlite3 and create DB bootstrap module
tasks.description:
Add better-sqlite3 and create a DB bootstrap module that opens/creates the SQLite file and enables foreign keys.

**What/Why:** REQ-028/AC-030 require better-sqlite3 for persistence. Foreign keys must be enabled for cascade delete (AC-006).

**Files:**
- `api/package.json` — add better-sqlite3, @types/better-sqlite3
- `api/src/db/index.ts` — DB bootstrap module

**Approach:**
1. Install better-sqlite3 and @types/better-sqlite3
2. Create db/index.ts:
   - Import Database from better-sqlite3
   - `const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || './data/todo.db'`
   - Ensure data directory exists (fs.mkdirSync with recursive)
   - `const db = new Database(DB_PATH)`
   - `db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')`
   - Export db instance and an `initSchema()` function (empty for now, will add tables in next task)
3. Call initSchema() on module load or export for server startup

**Tests:** Start API, verify `./data/todo.db` file is created; no errors on startup.

**Acceptance:** better-sqlite3 installs without native module errors; DB file created in data/ directory; foreign_keys pragma is ON.

tasks.title: Define projects table schema and data-access functions
tasks.description:
Define the projects table schema and typed CRUD data-access functions.

**What/Why:** The epic requires projects with id, name, description, created_at. Data-access module provides typed functions for REST routes.

**Files:**
- `api/src/db/index.ts` — update initSchema() with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
- `api/src/db/projects.ts` — typed data-access functions
- `api/src/types/project.ts` — Project interface

**Approach:**
1. Create types/project.ts: `interface Project { id: number; name: string; description: string | null; created_at: string; }`
2. Update db/index.ts initSchema():
   ```sql
   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     name TEXT NOT NULL,
     description TEXT,
     created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
   );
   ```
3. Create db/projects.ts with functions:
   - `createProject(name: string, description?: string): Project`
   - `listProjects(): (Project & { task_count: number })[]` — LEFT JOIN tasks (table may not exist yet, handle gracefully or add placeholder)
   - `getProject(id: number): Project | undefined`
   - `updateProject(id: number, data: { name?: string; description?: string }): Project | undefined`
   - `deleteProject(id: number): boolean`
4. Use prepared statements for all queries

**Tests:** Call each function manually via a test script or REPL; verify data round-trips.

**Acceptance:** Projects table created; all 5 CRUD functions work and return typed results; schema is idempotent (restarts don't error).

tasks.title: Build projects REST endpoints
tasks.description:
Implement the five REST endpoints for projects CRUD wired to the data-access module.

**What/Why:** AC-001-006 require creating, listing, editing, selecting, and deleting projects via REST.

**Files:**
- `api/src/routes/projects.ts` — Express Router with all endpoints
- `api/src/server.ts` — mount router at /api/projects

**Approach:**
1. Create routes/projects.ts with Router():
   - `POST /` — validate name required, call createProject, return 201 + project
   - `GET /` — call listProjects (with task_count), return 200 + array
   - `GET /:id` — call getProject, return 200 or 404
   - `PUT /:id` — validate body, call updateProject, return 200 or 404
   - `DELETE /:id` — call deleteProject, return 204 or 404
2. Add validation: name required for POST, id must be numeric
3. Return proper HTTP status codes and JSON error bodies
4. Mount in server.ts: `app.use('/api/projects', projectsRouter)`

**Tests:**
- POST with name returns 201 and project with id
- POST without name returns 400
- GET / returns array
- GET /:id returns project or 404
- PUT /:id updates and returns project or 404
- DELETE /:id returns 204 or 404

**Acceptance:** All 5 endpoints respond correctly; validation errors return 400; not-found returns 404.

tasks.title: Create typed API client module for web app
tasks.description:
Create a typed REST client for the web app that all Redux thunks will use.

**What/Why:** AC-029 requires browser access DB only via REST. A typed client ensures type safety and centralizes API calls.

**Files:**
- `web/src/api/client.ts` — base fetch wrapper with error handling
- `web/src/api/projects.ts` — typed project API functions
- `web/src/types/project.ts` — shared Project type (mirror of API type)

**Approach:**
1. Create types/project.ts with Project interface matching API response
2. Create api/client.ts:
   - Base URL from env or default to ''
   - `async function request<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T>` — handles JSON parsing, throws on non-ok
3. Create api/projects.ts:
   - `createProject(data: { name: string; description?: string }): Promise<Project>`
   - `listProjects(): Promise<ProjectWithCount[]>`
   - `getProject(id: number): Promise<Project>`
   - `updateProject(id: number, data: Partial<Project>): Promise<Project>`
   - `deleteProject(id: number): Promise<void>`

**Tests:** TypeScript compiles; functions are callable (integration tested via thunks later).

**Acceptance:** All 5 API functions exist with correct types; client handles JSON and errors.

tasks.title: Create projects Redux slice with async thunks
tasks.description:
Create the projects Redux slice with async thunks calling the API client, plus loading/error state.

**What/Why:** Redux manages UI state; thunks handle async API calls. Loading/error state provides user feedback.

**Files:**
- `web/src/store/projectsSlice.ts` — slice with state, reducers, thunks
- `web/src/store/index.ts` — add projects reducer to store

**Approach:**
1. Create projectsSlice.ts:
   - State: `{ items: Project[], selectedId: number | null, loading: boolean, error: string | null }`
   - Async thunks: `fetchProjects`, `createProject`, `updateProject`, `deleteProject`
   - Extra reducers handle pending/fulfilled/rejected for each thunk
   - Sync action: `selectProject(id)` to set selectedId
2. Export slice.reducer and all actions/thunks
3. Add to store: `reducer: { projects: projectsReducer }`

**Tests:** TypeScript compiles; can dispatch fetchProjects and state updates.

**Acceptance:** Slice exports reducer + thunks; store includes projects state; dispatching fetchProjects updates items array.

tasks.title: Build project list UI component
tasks.description:
Build the project list component showing name and task count for each project.

**What/Why:** AC-002 requires displaying every project with name and task count.

**Files:**
- `web/src/features/projects/ProjectList.tsx` — list component
- `web/src/App.tsx` — render ProjectList
- `web/src/index.css` or styles — basic styling

**Approach:**
1. Create ProjectList.tsx:
   - Use useAppSelector to get projects.items, loading, error
   - Use useAppDispatch + useEffect to fetchProjects on mount
   - Map projects to list items showing name and task_count
   - Show loading indicator when loading
   - Show error message when error
   - Highlight selected project (projects.selectedId)
2. Add click handler to dispatch selectProject(id)
3. Add to App.tsx in a sidebar layout

**Tests:** Start both servers; project list renders; creating a project via curl shows it after refresh.

**Acceptance:** Project list displays all projects with names and task counts; clicking selects; loading/error states visible.

tasks.title: Build project create/edit form
tasks.description:
Build the form component for creating and editing projects.

**What/Why:** AC-001/AC-003 require creating projects with name and editing name/description.

**Files:**
- `web/src/features/projects/ProjectForm.tsx` — form component
- `web/src/features/projects/ProjectList.tsx` — add create button, edit button per item

**Approach:**
1. Create ProjectForm.tsx:
   - Props: `project?: Project` (undefined = create mode), `onClose: () => void`
   - Controlled inputs for name (required) and description (optional)
   - On submit: dispatch createProject or updateProject thunk
   - Show validation error if name empty
   - Call onClose after successful save
2. Add state in ProjectList for showing form (create vs edit mode)
3. Add "New Project" button that opens form in create mode
4. Add edit button/icon per project that opens form in edit mode with project data

**Tests:** Create project via form — appears in list; edit project — changes persist after reload.

**Acceptance:** Can create project with name; can edit existing project; changes persist (reload shows them); validation prevents empty name.

tasks.title: Build project delete with confirmation prompt
tasks.description:
Implement project deletion with a confirmation prompt before cascade delete.

**What/Why:** AC-005/AC-006 require delete with confirmation. Cascade delete of tasks is DB-level (foreign key ready for tasks table).

**Files:**
- `web/src/features/projects/ProjectList.tsx` — add delete button with confirm
- `web/src/features/projects/ConfirmDialog.tsx` — reusable confirmation dialog (optional, can use window.confirm initially)

**Approach:**
1. Add delete button/icon per project in list
2. On click: show confirmation (start with `window.confirm('Delete project X and all its tasks?')`)
3. If confirmed: dispatch deleteProject thunk
4. After success: if deleted project was selected, clear selectedId
5. Handle error state if delete fails

**Schema note:** The projects table is ready; when tasks table is added later with `FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`, deletes will cascade automatically.

**Tests:** Delete project via UI with confirm — removed from list; cancel — project remains; deleted project stays gone after reload.

**Acceptance:** Delete button shows confirmation before deleting; confirmed delete removes project; canceled delete keeps project; deletion persists.

tasks.title: Document install and run commands in README
tasks.description:
Create README with install and run commands; verify data persists across restart.

**What/Why:** AC-027/AC-028 require documented commands and persistence verification.

**Files:**
- `README.md` — project documentation

**Approach:**
1. Create README.md with sections:
   - Project name and one-line description
   - Prerequisites (Node.js version, npm)
   - Install: `npm install`
   - Run development: `npm run dev` (starts both API and web)
   - Run API only: `npm run dev -w api`
   - Run web only: `npm run dev -w web`
   - Build: `npm run build`
   - Data location: `./data/todo.db`
2. Document that data persists in SQLite file across restarts
3. Note: better-sqlite3 requires Node.js version compatible with native modules

**Tests:** Follow README steps on clean clone — app runs.

**Acceptance:** README exists with clear install/run commands; following them starts the app successfully.

tasks.title: Add integration tests for projects endpoints
tasks.description:
Add integration tests for all five projects endpoints covering happy path, not-found, and validation errors.

**What/Why:** Epic requires integration tests for all endpoints plus smoke test for web build and store init.

**Files:**
- `api/package.json` — add vitest, supertest
- `api/vitest.config.ts` — test config
- `api/src/routes/projects.test.ts` — integration tests
- `web/package.json` — add vitest
- `web/src/store/index.test.ts` — smoke test for store init

**Approach:**
1. API tests (using supertest):
   - POST /api/projects — valid returns 201 + project; missing name returns 400
   - GET /api/projects — returns array (empty or with items)
   - GET /api/projects/:id — existing returns 200; non-existent returns 404
   - PUT /api/projects/:id — existing updates and returns 200; non-existent returns 404
   - DELETE /api/projects/:id — existing returns 204; non-existent returns 404
2. Use test DB (in-memory or temp file) to isolate tests
3. Web smoke test: import store, assert it initializes without error
4. Add test scripts to both package.json files

**Tests:** `npm test -w api` and `npm test -w web` pass.

**Acceptance:** All endpoint tests pass; validation errors tested; 404 cases tested; web store smoke test passes.
